modifiers.note: Town Centers and Citadel Centers support +5 population (applies to the starting TC too: 20).
Technologies cost -10% Food/Wood/Gold (not Favor; age-ups and Secrets of the Titans excluded).
Priests build Obelisks 40% faster (rate x1.4 => time /1.4).
Only while a Monument is empowered by a Pharaoh: empower favor bonus becomes x2.0 instead of x1.2 (1.2 x 1.667).

meta.source: Extracted game data, AoM Retold build 19.17020 (Data.bar: gameplay/proto.xml, techtree.xml, major_gods.xml) (ArchaicAge<God> tech, STR_CIV_*_LR, string_replacement_values.xml); cross-checked: https://ageofempires.fandom.com/wiki/Ra , /Isis , /Set (Bonuses sections)
meta.note: Other bonuses: Monuments block enemy god powers within 25 (50 when empowered); empowered Monuments heal nearby units (50 range). Prosperity recharge 120 s.
